string.text: A scientific device designed specifically to study the Zone. Its sturdy casing combines an artifact detector, an autonomous power supply, and a powerful transmitter. It can detect anomalies and determine the number and type of artifacts forming inside them. Place the device in an anomalous area, then hand it over to the customer for analysis of the scan results.
Anomalous Activity Scanner
A laptop in a shockproof, sealed case. A physical key is required to turn it on. Models like this have become common in the Zone and are widely used for various field tasks.
Protected Laptop

Special protected container for documents. Surprisingly, it is unlocked. A quick glance reveals: ..Prototype device 4-SAI, test name Sense, model 6.. Tests were run in several anomalous areas.. Scanning firmware version v-31.. Power use 21.4% above normal.. Prototype tested in the central region, sectors D-6 and B-8.. It successfully displayed gravitational and chemical anomalies... Further calibration required to correct defects.. Tester death report.. Tester entered a class 4 electro-anomaly.. Prototype needs improvement before further trials..
Document Container
A heavy wooden crate reinforced with a metal frame, with a sturdy padlock hanging from its hinges. Cheap and cheerful. Its only drawback is the weight, which is the carrier problem.
Wooden Crate

A black fabric bag with a neat little travel lock. It can be opened with a knife in just a couple of minutes. The lock seems less about security and more about making the consequences of breaking in obvious.
Bag with Padlock

A small bag with a Fastex buckle. Inside is a sealed pouch with flash drives and maps with encrypted coordinates written by hand in the upper-right corner. GECNMDKF2JHFNJHB32PFRHSN.. the rest is illegible.
Bag with Fastex Buckle
An extremely heavy metal case with serious protection against break-ins. Someone clearly does not want its contents to fall into the wrong hands.
Metal Case
An extremely heavy metal case with serious protection against break-ins. Someone clearly does not want its contents to fall into the wrong hands.
Metal Case

A protected device for scanning psi emissions. Some buttons and switches have already been pressed under the transparent cover, and technical data appears on the small display. Its large built-in battery makes it heavy.
Psi Activity Scanner
A lost PDA belonging to some stalker. It is slightly bloodstained and the screen is broken. Its owner must have been in serious trouble. If the electronics still work, it may contain useful data.
Stalker PDA

A map printout, a floppy disk, and several documents are sealed in a bag. A quick glance reveals: ..Mutant attack two days after the Super-Emission. First line of resistance: Army Warehouses.. Lukash accepts a temporary truce with Skull’s squad.. Duty takes positions at Freedom base.. On the second day ammunition was nearly gone.. Ammunition and food deliveries were difficult.. The military dropped supplies by helicopter.. Heavy personnel losses.. Evacuation ordered.. Skull’s squad refuses Lukash orders and evacuation.. Freedom retreats through the eastern tunnel into Dark Valley catacombs.. Some Freedom fighters stay with Skull’s squad to hold off the mutants.. Explosion on the east side of the military base; catacomb entrance buried.. Fate of the rearguard unknown.. Recon report No. 4.. Bodies found: the rearguard, Skull’s squad and twelve Freedom fighters; total dead: 37.
Data Package
Circuit boards from an unknown device, sealed in a bag. Several research groups appeared in the Zone after the Super-Emission. They seem to be experimenting with new types of anomalies.
Device Circuit Boards

A set of crude pressure-activated mines loaded with high-explosive fragmentation charges. Each casing has a safety clip. They resemble old anti-personnel mines. Recently they have been used to block vital routes against mutants. Every stalker receives a network alert about these little gifts, yet someone still manages to set one off from time to time.
Bag of Fragmentation Mines
This PDA belonged to a stalker who never returned from a raid. Its memory contains the last known lead: the coordinates of a stash. Maybe it was their emergency reserve...
Guidance PDA
